body:
Hey, I've recently started Pursuit Gaming Clan with a bunch of friends. This is a legitimate Minecraft Gaming clan and note that it's not PURELY For Avicus. We play on a lot of different servers, record and do a bunch more stuff! We're looking for some really good Minecraft players to join us and if you're interested add me on skype: xTullyPlays

Channel -  https://www.youtube.com/user/PursuitGamingClan/featured

Thanks :D
